crew.original_title: The Death & Life of John F. Donovan
crew.overview: A decade after the death of an American TV star, a young actor reminisces about the written correspondence he once shared with the former, as well as the impact those letters had on both their lives.
crew.title: The Death & Life of John F. Donovan

crew.overview: An ordinary young boy called Nikolas sets out on an extraordinary adventure into the snowy north in search of his father who is on a quest to discover the fabled village of the elves, Elfhelm. Taking with him a headstrong reindeer called Blitzen and a loyal pet mouse, Nikolas soon meets his destiny in this magical and endearing story that proves nothing is impossible…
crew.title: A Boy Called Christmas

crew.overview: Brought back to life by an unorthodox scientist, a young woman runs off with a lawyer on a whirlwind adventure across the continents. Free from the prejudices of her times, she grows steadfast in her purpose to stand for equality and liberation.
crew.title: Poor Things

crew.overview: The true story of the inseparable Von Erich brothers, who made history in the intensely competitive world of professional wrestling in the early 1980s. Through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, the brothers seek larger-than-life immortality on the biggest stage in sports.
crew.title: The Iron Claw

crew.overview: Paddington, now happily settled with the Browns, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy, but it is stolen.
crew.title: Paddington 2

crew.overview: When an American family is invited to spend the weekend at the idyllic country estate of a charming British family they befriended on vacation, what begins as a dream holiday soon warps into a snarled psychological nightmare.
crew.title: Speak No Evil

details.biography: James Price, a British production designer, is celebrated for his work on Poor Things (2023), Speak No Evil (2024), and The Iron Claw (2023). Initially an art director on projects like Paddington (2014), he transitioned to production design, creating visually striking worlds. Teaming with Shona Heath, he won an Oscar and BAFTA for Poor Things' surreal sets. His collaborations with directors like Yorgos Lanthimos and Sean Durkin showcase his ability to merge realism with imaginative aesthetics.
details.name: James Price
